_help.tipSeconds: How long a tutorial callout stays up before it fades, unless you tap it. Try 6–10.
_help.selfTangleBy: Sprout (the tutorial game's AI) starts preferring moves that walk ONE of its glyphlings into a pocket — next to your pieces when it can, so you see the tangle bonus — from this turn of its own. Lower = it happens sooner. A preference, never a rule: if the board offers no pocket, it doesn't happen. Try 4–8.
_help.maxTurns: After this many of its own turns Sprout drops both its preferences (one self-tangle, then keeping its other glyphling free) and plays like any Apprentice. Sims (npm run sim:sprout, 2026-10-13): a Small game is ~22–25 of Sprout's turns, so at 20 its last few turns are plain Apprentice ones. Try 15–30.
_help.railsCalloutDelay: The tutorial game's first 2 turns: how long after the game goes quiet (a glide, a seed landing, the score) the next callout shows. Lower = snappier, higher = calmer. Try 0.3–1.2.
_help.railsDim: How dark a tutorial pause (Got it / Play) makes the rest of the game. 0 = not at all, 1 = black. Try 0.5–0.75.
